$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-substrate-alias-degenerate.xml (Rule 10, D-030). Task 14's negative case. AliasIdType declares BOTH @Type and @Value use="required", so an empty @Value is schema-valid and prose-invalid: the element is present and addresses nothing - E142_XML_ID_EMPTY, carried rather than dropped so a reader can see what the producer emitted. The third alias is 33 characters, one past MaterialIdType's maxLength 32 - E142_XML_ID_TOO_LONG, and the value survives UNTRUNCATED, because an alias is a join key and a shortened one silently joins to nothing. The fourth has an empty @Type and is reported by nothing at all: the type vocabulary is OPEN, Table 7 gives examples and declares no restriction, so there is no facet to violate. That asymmetry between @Type and @Value is the point of the fixture.
